newsitem.title: FINLAND: STOCKMANN, MERITA TO LAUNCH JOINT CARD.
newsitem.headline: STOCKMANN, MERITA TO LAUNCH JOINT CARD.

text.p: Finnish retailer Oy Stockmann Ab and banking group Merita Oy said on Wednesday they will launch a combination card for their mutual customers.

"Merita Bank and ... Stockmann have agreed to offer their mutual customers a combination card functioning both as a Merita Bank card and as a Stockmann loyal customer card with or without a credit facility," Stockmann said in a statement.
Stockmann said it will offer its loyal customers an option to withdraw cash with the new card at its department stores and other business outlets from Merita accounts.
The new combination card will be available in February 1998 and the production and distribution costs will be shared between the partners.

In a different statement Merita said that from September 1, it will no longer charge customers using the bank's self-service Solo money transfer system when purchasing goods or services on the internet.
